comparison.objective: Candidate separates ceramic media from finished washers; record calibrates a colorimeter and measures a sealed sample.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate tests load sharing and granular-flow control; record tests reference-dependent cuvette selection, oriented insertion, lid/button operation and instrument workflow.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate grades physical separation yield and retained parts; record requires a valid calibrated reading at the requested wavelength and both cuvettes returned, released and still.
comparison.reason: Instrument calibration and reference-dependent measurement are unrelated to physical screening despite both handling multiple small objects.
